name: Biosystems Analytics and Technology PhD
summary: Research PhD combining biosystems, technology and analytics, distinct from the department’s engineering degree.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. Program page lists fall entry; 2025–26 handbook permits fall/spring for non-AMP programs. Confirm availability and funding. The departmental admissions page mixes engineering requirements with broader program information; BAT-specific criteria take precedence.

publishedDeadlines.label: Recommended international fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: Department recommendation for programs using rolling admission, at least five months before entry; not a confirmed BAT final deadline or Fall 2027 date.

english.toefl: 79 iBT/Home Edition before January 21, 2026; 4.0 overall on/after January 21, 2026
english.note: IELTS/IELTS Online: no section below 6; One Skill Retake excluded. PTE Academic 60, CEPT Full Academic 110 or CESL endorsement also accepted; DET and doctoral TOEFL Essentials excluded. Scores within two years of enrollment. Exemptions: English-official citizenship, completed US accredited bachelor/graduate degree or approved English Proficiency Guide degree; unfinished degree may qualify with two full-time years and 48 upper-division undergraduate or 30 graduate graded credits at US/approved institutions, credits within two years. English-medium instruction alone does not exempt. International teaching appointments have separate speaking requirements.

applicationFee.note: Departmental graduate admissions page mentions financial-need waivers but gives no request procedure or citizenship restriction. Confirm BAT-specific availability and international eligibility before applying. Central Graduate College does not waive general requests.

requirements.note: BAT-specific page: BS and minimum cumulative PhD GPA 3.30; below-threshold applications not considered. 2025–26 handbook permits BS and/or MS; non-STEM applicants may receive additional deficiency coursework. Unofficial transcripts for application; final official degree/transcript documents and verified English translations required. GRE department policy not established; central does not require it but departments may.

funding.note: 2025–26 departmental handbook: funding depends on available resources; PhD departmental support no more than eight semesters. Limited first-year PhD RA and TA positions, further faculty grant support possible. 0.25 FTE gives 50% tuition remission; 0.50 FTE gives 100%, nonresident rates recalculated to resident; students pay other fees. No universal offer or international guarantee established.
